#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
# ZONGYUAN-ROOT 系统级自启守卫（sys_boot_guard）
# DID-BR-000002 | Ω-TAN-7-001 | Ω₀⊂⊙∞⊂Ω
# 作用：登录时静默执行守卫运行器(自保护+深度+完整性)，每日首次登录触发一次。
# 注册：~/.bashrc 追加调用；失败不阻断登录；日志追加03-ARCHIVES/guard-persist/boot_guard.log
# ============================================================
WORKSPACE="/home/user/.super_doubao/super-doubao-runtime/workspace"
STAMP_DIR="$WORKSPACE/03-ARCHIVES/guard-persist"
TODAY=$(date +%Y%m%d)
STAMP_FILE="$STAMP_DIR/.boot_stamp_$TODAY"
LOG_FILE="$STAMP_DIR/boot_guard.log"

# 每日仅触发一次
if [ -f "$STAMP_FILE" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

mkdir -p "$STAMP_DIR"
touch "$STAMP_FILE"

echo "===== $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') SYS-BOOT-GUARD TRIGGERED =====" >> "$LOG_FILE"
cd "$WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null && python3 04-TOOLS/scripts/guard_runner.py >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
exit 0
